bundle.shortDescription: Sovereign desktop PDF viewer and print tool
bundle.longDescription: Sovereign desktop PDF viewer and print tool. Renders PDF documents locally with the PDFium engine — open, navigate, zoom, and print via the OS print dialogue. No document data leaves the machine.

_notes.tauri-version: v1.x — required for macOS 10.13 High Sierra. Upgrade to v2 when dev machine targets macOS 10.15+.
_notes.pdfium: Rendering uses pdfium-render bound dynamically to libpdfium at runtime (see src-tauri/pdfium/README.md for provenance + search order). The shipped macOS build must statically link libpdfium.a per CLAUDE.md — switch pdfium-render to its 'static' feature for release.
_notes.print: Print renders every page to PNG at 1600px width in a hidden print container, then calls appWindow.print() (allowlist window.print) so macOS shows the native print dialogue; falls back to window.print(). Output is raster at the render width, not vector.
_notes.csp: img-src allows data: because rendered pages arrive as base64 PNG data URIs over IPC.
_notes.icons: Copy icons from app-workplace-memo/src-tauri/icons/ before first macOS build.
